title: Personality and Burnout in Esports
descriptions: 453 complete responses on resilience, mental toughness, coping, burnout surveys Resilience (RISC-10; Personality). (Connor & Davidson, 2003) Mental toughness (MTQ-18; Personality). Sub-factors: challenge, commitment, control (emotion/life), and confidence (interpersonal/ability). (Dagnall et al., 2019) Coping (CFQ-18; Psychological skills). Sub-factors: Problem-focused coping, Emotion-focused coping, Avoidance Coping. (Kowalski & Crocker, 2001) Burnout (ABO-S-15; Outcome variable). Subfactors: Exhaustion, Sport Devaluation, Reduced Accomplishment. (Isoard-Gautheur et al., 2018)
